name: Management
description: You manage an Aslan corporation or serve in another bureaucracy. Many female Aslan opt to enter a business-oriented career, rather than pursuing marriage and family.

corporate.name: Corporate
corporate.description: You work as an administrator or trader in one of the great Aslan corporations.

clan_aide.name: Clan Aide
clan_aide.description: You serve in the bureaucracy of your clan.

governess.name: Governess
governess.description: You are the protector and teacher of a rich Aslan prince.

mishaps.1: Injured. Roll on the Injury table.
mishaps.2: You are accused of stealing from your employer. If this is true, gain 3 Benefit rolls and become Outcast, dropping your SOC to 2. If it is false, roll Advocate 8+ to defend yourself. If you fail, you leave this career; if you succeed, you may remain in this career.
mishaps.3: A shift in clan politics leaves you shut out in the cold. Gain a Contact who stays in touch despite your new status.
mishaps.4: Your clan's fortunes decline. You may continue in this career if you wish but you will gain no Benefit rolls this term or the next.
mishaps.5: You are sent to a border world, where your career stagnates. Gain Survival 1, Flyer 1, Profession 1 or Navigation 1.
mishaps.6: A clan elder takes a dislike to you. Gain her as a Rival.

events.2: Disaster! Roll on the Mishap table but you are not ejected from this career.
events.3: A rival clan attacks and your place of work is targeted by an assault force. Roll Melee (Natural), Stealth or Gun Combat 8+. If you succeed, gain any skill. If you fail, roll on the Injury table.
events.4: You pick up some useful skills. Gain Pilot 1, Mechanic 1, Electronics 1 or Drive 1.
events.5: You have the opportunity to take a risk in business. Wager up to three Benefit rolls and roll Broker 8+. If you succeed, gain an equal number of Benefit rolls to those you wagered. If you fail, lose any wagered Benefits.
events.6: You are given advanced training in a specialist field. Roll EDU 8+ to gain any skill.
events.7: Life Event. Roll on the Aslan Life Events table.
events.8: You expand into new territories. Gain Broker 1, Profession 1, Streetwise 1 or a Contact.
events.9: A foolish decision by a clan member threatens your business. Roll Diplomat or Admin 8+ to fix the damage. If you succeed, gain that clan member as a Rival. If you fail, you suffer DM-2 to your next advancement roll.
events.10: Your clan thrives and prospers. Gain DM+2 to your next advancement roll.
events.11: You trade with aliens and barbarians. Gain Tolerance 1, or gain DM+4 to your next advancement roll.
events.12: You excel in your role. You are automatically promoted.
